questions.stem: If $m(\angle C) > m(\angle A)$ then $AB \ldots\ldots BC$
solution: The right angle is at B, so AC is the hypotenuse.
AB is the side opposite angle C, and BC is the side opposite angle A.
In a triangle the larger angle has the larger opposite side.
